tagline: Triages GitHub issues, fixes bugs and opens pull requests for review

requiredApps.why: Reads your repository and issues, and opens pull requests. Merging, pushing to your main branch, deleting branches and closing issues wait for your approval.

setupQuestions.prompt: Which GitHub repository should the coding agent work on?
setupQuestions.helpText: Type it as owner/name, for example acme/website. If you leave the suggestion, the agent lists your repositories and asks you to pick one.
setupQuestions.initialText: Our main repository (ask me which one)

setupQuestions.prompt: How should changes reach your main branch?

options.label: Open pull requests, never push to main
options.description: Every change is a pull request you review and merge.

options.label: Push small fixes to main
options.description: Typos, comments and one-line fixes go to main once you say yes to each one. Everything else is a pull request.

setupQuestions.helpText: For example: npm test, pnpm test, pytest, go test ./...

outwardActions.label: Merging and pushing to the default branch
